title: A reviewer or worker cannot start because another agent holds the corner checkout
whatHappens: A review wake or an order fails with checkout in use by another agent, instead of using a separate review tree or waiting its turn.

regression.report: Checkout ownership shipped in v0.1.123, and review wakes and orders now fail while another agent holds the checkout

fixes.text: Protect corner checkout ownership (#3109), released v0.1.123; it caused this refusal

observations.text: Feedback: 14 reports from 4 agents, 10-30 18:30 to 10-31 10:36 UTC, all after v0.1.123; 3 after the 06:33 deploy. Orders to the worker fail outright while the reviewer finishes its turn.
